subheadings.rawText: Motivated and Safety-conscious professional with hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment at Grupo Bimbo Canada. Proven ability to train and onboard new associates, enforce safety protocols, and collaborate effectively across multiple departments to maintain seamless operations. Strong communicator and team player with additional experience coordinating with clients, gathering requirements, and meeting tight deadlines in a collaborative environment. Seeking a role where I can leverage my leadership, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills to drive safe and efficient operations.

resumeItems: Train and onboard new associates on safe equipment operation, workplace procedures, and company safety protocols, ensuring all team members meet compliance standards.
Walk new hires through safety procedures, emergency response plans, and standard operating protocols and training process.
Collaborate across multiple departments including production, sanitation, quality assurance, and shipping to coordinate daily operations and resolve workflow issues.
Document activities meticulously, maintaining detailed logs to track operational efficiency and contributing to reduction in downtime.
Operate and monitor production machinery in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating a keen eye for detail and a strong commitment to quality and safety.
Communicate effectively with team members, supervisors, and employees from different departments to ensure seamless operations and timely resolution of issues.
Recognized by management for strong interpersonal skills, dependability, and the ability to adapt to changing task priorities and shifting work schedules.
Support inventory management and material handling within the production facility, ensuring adequate supplies across workstations.
Collaborated directly with clients and stakeholders to gather, document, and clarify project requirements, ensuring alignment between deliverables and business needs.
Worked under tight deadlines to deliver project milestones on schedule, consistently meeting or exceeding client expectations.
Participated in cross-functional team meetings to provide progress updates, discuss challenges, and coordinate next steps across departments.
Maintained detailed documentation of project requirements, workflows, and status reports for internal and external stakeholders.
Assisted with testing and quality assurance to verify that deliverables met specified requirements and standards before client handoff.
\textbf{Microsoft Office Suite}: Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams.
Data Entry, Reporting and Documentation Tools.
Inventory Tracking and Production Logging Tools.
